not_claimed: The numeric second argument of AddTranscendentalClassItem is recorded as "transcendental_stage" (observed values 0/1/2). The native code does not name it; the label is a description of the observed value, not a decoded enum.
UT_NONE and UT_END exist in the client UNIT_TYPE table but are not registered as transcendental unit types, so they are deliberately absent.
No item name is resolved here; the string tables that would name these items are still encrypted.
policy: Read-only catalog. It answers "what does this item unlock" and never grants an unlock by itself.
provenance: Native AddTranscendentalClassItem / AddMasterClassItem / AddTranscendentalUnitType registrations. An item may appear in both the transcendental and the master-class registration; the "items" entry then carries both keys instead of being deduplicated away.
